document.abstract: The Army and Air Force Motion Picture Service is a self-supporting agency of the Department of Defense. Its mission is the presentation of entertainment motion pictures for morale purposes. Recent innovations in the industry necessitated a major replacement program. Methods of testing, bases of design and the determining effect of military operating conditions on choice of equipment are briefly described.
